dominance_matrix.description: 10x10 matrix showing subsumption relationships. Entry (i,j) = true if Agent i subsumes Agent j. All entries are null (no subsumption) = monoidal composition.

invariant_coverage_map.description: Which agents enforce which of the 5 binding invariants. Each invariant must be enforced by ≥1 agent.

invariants.name: C-ABI Sovereignty
invariants.definition: All C++ internal structures must be hidden behind opaque FFI handles. FFI overhead < 0.1% of query time.

invariants.name: Zero-Copy Absolute
invariants.definition: No memcpy permitted in Join/Filter/IndexScan hot-paths. eBPF overhead < 2%.

invariants.name: Bit-Parity Requirement
invariants.definition: Query results must be bit-identical across ARM (NEON) and x86 (AVX-512). digest(ARM) == digest(x86).
invariants.enforcement_method: Validation (Agent 4 QEMU) + Static Proof (Agent 9 Instruction Mask)

invariants.name: FPV Closure
invariants.definition: No code implementation without formal property verification (RapidCheck + Kani) sign-off.
invariants.enforcement_method: Specification-level gate, gates all code agents

invariants.name: Memory Isolation
invariants.definition: All memory access routes through FFI opaque handles. No direct pointer access. eBPF read-only. Chaos validation under isolation.
invariants.enforcement_method: Static Guards (Agent 5) → Runtime Observation (Agent 6) → Adversarial Validation (Agent 7)

selection_pressure_analysis.description: Per EPIC 9, selection pressure evaluates: coverage, invariant preservation, eliminable redundancy, minimality.

agents.name: FFI Architect
agents.coverage: Defines C-ABI surface (opaque handles, FFI functions)
agents.eliminable_reason: Only FFI header in codebase; required by Agents 5, 8
agents.minimality_reason: Uses opaque handles and shared memory pointers; no unnecessary complexity

agents.name: FPV Auditor
agents.coverage: Formal verification of Join/Filter/IndexScan kernels; gates all code agents
agents.eliminable_reason: Non-negotiable specification-level gate; cannot be skipped or merged
agents.minimality_reason: MC/DC coverage for 1B permutations; minimal sufficient proof budget

agents.name: Unified Planner
agents.coverage: Unifies SPARQL, Datalog, SHACL into single execution graph; new capability
agents.eliminable_reason: New component (not refactor); no existing artifact to subsume
agents.minimality_reason: Focus-Node Injection + Semi-Naive blocks; focused on constraint push-down

agents.name: Arch-Agnostic Digest
agents.coverage: Cross-architecture validation (ARM NEON, x86 AVX-512); empirical bit-parity proof
agents.eliminable_reason: Overlaps semantically with Agent 9, but complementary (validation vs. static proof); cannot merge without loss
agents.minimality_reason: QEMU cross-compilation + 1M query corpus; minimal sufficient test set

agents.name: Opaque Memory
agents.coverage: Memory boundary enforcement; strict isolation behind FFI gate
agents.eliminable_reason: Overlaps semantically with Agents 1, 8 on C-ABI, but non-redundant (design → enforce → validate)
agents.minimality_reason: Memory guards + reference counting; minimal enforcement mechanism

agents.name: OOB Telemetry
agents.coverage: Observability via eBPF uprobes (Join, Filter, IndexScan); operationally essential
agents.eliminable_reason: Orthogonal observability approach; no overlap with other agents
agents.minimality_reason: 4 uprobes + 1.5% overhead measurement; minimal instrumentation for insight

agents.name: Chaos Invariance
agents.coverage: Adversarial correctness validation (bit-flip injection); empirical chaos proof
agents.eliminable_reason: Overlaps semantically with Agent 2 on correctness, but complementary (formal vs. adversarial)
agents.minimality_reason: pwrite bit-flip injection + 100+ test scenarios; minimal sufficient chaos budget

agents.name: FFI Gatekeeper
agents.coverage: Performance gate validation (FFI overhead < 0.1%); SLA enforcement
agents.eliminable_reason: Overlaps semantically with Agents 1, 5, 6 on performance, but non-redundant (gating function)
agents.minimality_reason: Micro-benchmarks + p50/p95/p99 latency; minimal performance validation

agents.name: The Instruction Mask
agents.coverage: Architecture-neutral proof + hardware flag extraction; static isolation proof
agents.eliminable_reason: Overlaps semantically with Agent 4, but complementary (static proof vs. empirical validation)
agents.minimality_reason: Flag extraction + qleverest::vmath isolation; minimal static proof

agents.name: Final Obsidian Seal
agents.coverage: Seals all artifacts into obsidian.manifest.cbor for Epic 11 handoff
agents.eliminable_reason: Only artifact producing final sealed manifest; non-negotiable for Epic 11
agents.minimality_reason: CBOR format + abi_version/fpv_witness/kernel_digests; minimal sealed representation
